APOLO.Connect: Click to listen to the Apolo audio
APOLO.CalledByGM: The GM is playing music with Apolo.
APOLO.NoStream: Apolo: the GM has not set the stream ID yet (Module Settings).
APOLO.Settings.StreamId.Name: Apolo stream ID
APOLO.Settings.StreamId.Hint: Paste the listener link or the ID shown in Apolo (button "Share via VDO.Ninja"). Example: https://vdo.ninja/?view=myid or just myid.
APOLO.Settings.AutoConnect.Name: Connect automatically
APOLO.Settings.AutoConnect.Hint: Starts listening by itself after your first click in Foundry (browsers only allow sound after a click).
APOLO.Settings.GMListens.Name: GM also listens through Foundry
APOLO.Settings.GMListens.Hint: Keep this off on the computer that runs Apolo, otherwise you hear everything twice.
APOLO.Settings.ResetPosition.Name: Reset button position
APOLO.Settings.ResetPosition.Hint: Check and save to bring the Apolo button back to its default place.
APOLO.Settings.UiMode.Name: Where to show the Apolo controls
APOLO.Settings.UiMode.Hint: Sidebar: inside the Playlists tab, next to the Foundry volume sliders. Floating: a draggable button over the game.
APOLO.PickIntro: Players checked here get the pause, previous, next and stop buttons.
APOLO.NoPlayers: There are no players in this world yet.
APOLO.Settings.Controllers.Name: Players who control the music
APOLO.Settings.Controllers.Hint: The chosen players see pause / previous / next / stop in the Apolo row of the Playlists tab. It works while the GM has Foundry open on the same computer as Apolo.
